# PRESSURE VESSEL INSPECTION REPORT

**Report No:** INS-PV-0087
**Date of Inspection:** 03-Sep-2026
**Equipment ID:** V-2201 (Knockout Drum)
**Design Pressure:** 10.5 kg/cm2g | **Design Temperature:** 120°C
**Inspector:** S. Menon, Authorized Inspector

## 1. Scope
Internal and external inspection as part of statutory shutdown inspection under Factories Act / OISD-130 requirements.

## 2. External Inspection
- Shell and heads: No visible bulging, denting, or mechanical damage
- Nozzle connections: Satisfactory, no leakage marks
- Support skirt: Minor surface rust, no structural concern
- Safety relief valve: Set pressure verified at 11.5 kg/cm2g, functioning within tolerance

## 3. Internal Inspection
- Internal surfaces free of significant pitting corrosion
- Weld seams inspected visually — no cracks or defects observed
- Demister pad intact, no fouling observed
- Minor scale deposit near liquid outlet nozzle, recommend cleaning

## 4. Thickness Survey Summary
| Component | Original (mm) | Current (mm) | Corrosion Allowance Remaining |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shell (Top) | 12.0 | 11.6 | 87% |
| Shell (Bottom) | 12.0 | 11.2 | 78% |
| Head (Top) | 14.0 | 13.7 | 91% |

## 5. Findings Summary
Vessel is structurally sound. No immediate repair required. Minor housekeeping item (scale removal) to be closed before commissioning.

## 6. Recommendation
- Approve for continued service until next statutory inspection cycle (5 years, or as per applicable regulation).
- Close housekeeping item within current shutdown window.

**Status: APPROVED FOR SERVICE**
**Next Statutory Inspection Due:** Sep-2031
